data: Which of the following assumes a value of 2 throughout the range of x values?

The green line represents the total variation squared (TV^2), which is a measure of the difference between two probability distributions. The caption mentions that the loss-truncated bound has a nearly identical minimizer to directly minimizing total variation. This suggests that the TV^2 line is the one that assumes a value of 2 throughout the range of x values. Therefore, the correct answer is the green line.
